_description: URL action: selecting a mark opens a URL built from a field on that mark (Tableau Cloud accepted this exact shape)

action._placement: Child of the top-level <actions> element (after </datasources>, before <worksheets>)

notes.expression: A URL template. Each field is written <[datasource].[column-instance]> (escaped as <...> in the XML attribute) and may be mixed with literal text, e.g. https://example.com/search?q=<[federated.XXXX].[none:Song:nk]>.
notes.field_must_be_in_view: Every field used in the expression must be in the source sheet's view; if it isn't on a shelf, add it to Detail (<lod column='...' /> under the pane's <encodings>) and declare its column/column-instance in <datasource-dependencies>.
notes.verify: Click a mark in the live view to confirm the link resolves; the PNG render can't show it.
